Had multiple issues. 
First off, we were told we would be provided transportation to and from our tour date. When we called to schedule transportation, we were informed they no longer do that. Even though when we checked into our hotel the lady at the desk gave us a number to call to do so. 
I understand because of COVID they no longer provide that. Just wish we had been told sooner, rather than the day before our tour so we could have better planned. 
Secondly, was told we would receive $199 CASH BACK after our tour was completed. They no longer do cash back, I’m assuming because of COVID. Once again, that’s understandable, just wish we had been told sooner rather than AFTER the tour was over. 
Here’s the biggest problem.
 I have a different card than when I booked the vacation. I told them this the day of the tour. They informed me that as long as I had the same bank account info (which I do), it would go back into my account a few days later. 12 business days later and still no money. The first 2 customer service people informed me that it would go back on my card. The second lady told me she would find out why they didn’t refund me and give me a call back the next week. Never called me back. I called them again, a week later, and the 3rd customer service lady was extremely rude from the get go. She told me they cannot refund my money back to my account if I don’t have the same card. They’ve never done this and aren’t sure why they told me they could. They also had the account under my boyfriends first name and my last name. I’m not sure how. He didn’t book it or pay for it, nor was it his bank account or card. She then told me she would have to mail me a check to the address of which I was at at the time of purchasing the package and it would take 4-6weeks! I was supposed to get the cash back the day of the tour! Good thing I wasn’t counting on that money. I told her I had also moved since then. (I bought the package pre-Covid) She told me she would send the check to my new address. Gave her the address and told her to make sure it was under my name, and not my boyfriends, since that person doesn’t exist and we wouldn’t be able to cash the check(since they had his first name and my last name on the account). She was extremely rude and unhelpful. Asked if there was a supervisor I could talk to, since she was being so rude and this was the 3rd person who is now telling me something different. She told me she did not have a supervisor. Called back later to confirm that they had the right address, name and to make sure it was an actual check and not a prepaid debit card or spend a night on us or something of the sort. 
The 4th person I talked to was very helpful and polite from the start. He did tell me that they’d have to send me a check, and it would take up to 8 weeks. He also told me that the previous lady had not updated my info and that it was being sent to my old address and being sent to an incorrect name. He supposedly fixed it and emailed his leadership team (what do you know?! They do have supervisors and leadership!) to ensure it was fixed and I eventually get my check. We will see. I’m not too confident after this whole ordeal.
